items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Camille Howard, she'd sing and play, and Roy would sing...

ctx.x: But anyway, I worked there with Roy Milton. It was nice. Camille Howard, she'd sing and play, and Roy would sing... They were a real entertaining Blues type of band. And the tenor player, Buddy Floyd, he really impressed me, the way he could get to an audience. Now, this guy could only play three or four notes in a solo. But what he could with those three or four notes was spectacular. In fact, I did some things not too long ago when I did a slow Blues thing, and I had him in my mind when I was playing this slow…
